name: elsewhere
description: Fetch it from elsewhere — read URLs through your own VLESS/Xray tunnel exits or a genuinely direct path, as MCP tools.
long_description:
Three read-only MCP tools — elsewhere_fetch, elsewhere_whoami, elsewhere_exits — that read URLs through named tunnel exits or the machine's own path past any system VPN, so an unreachable page is read, not guessed.

IMPORTANT — this bundle does NOT contain the `elsewhere` binary. A compiled Swift binary is per-architecture, and a copy frozen into Desktop's extension folder would be invisible to your other MCP hosts and stale the moment you rebuild — so the bundle instead points at an `elsewhere` executable you build once from source (`swift build -c release` in the elsewhere repo) and place on a stable path. One binary then serves every host on the machine and stays current with each release build. Set the path below; see the repo SETUP.md if you don't have it yet.

binary_path.title: elsewhere binary
binary_path.description: Absolute path to the elsewhere executable. NOT bundled: build it with `swift build -c release` in the elsewhere repo and symlink it to a stable path so every rebuild stays in sync. See the repo SETUP.md.
